summary: Frontier Nuclear & Minerals Inc. filed a Form 6-K announcing a partnership with DISA Technologies Inc. for remediation and uranium recovery at the Maybell uranium project in Colorado. DISA will use its HPSA system to recover saleable uranium from legacy waste dumps, with Frontier receiving a sliding-scale net revenue royalty of 2.5%-4% on uranium price. DISA bears all costs. This is a service/revenue agreement, not an acquisition, divestiture, or special situation. No specific deal terms or vote required. Watch for regulatory approvals and royalty revenue commencement.
